$comment: Pilot: metric check (matrix). Hierarchical rows × columns to spot the cell that stands out. Change only rows, columns, values and format (heat · bar · sign). expand opens every row level.
name: Pilot-Matrix

Headline Heatmap.en: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( '날짜'[월] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [매출] ) ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], DESC ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], ASC ) RETURN "Peak month: " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, '날짜'[월], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MAXX ( hi, [매출] ) / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M  ·  Low month: " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, '날짜'[월], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [매출] ) / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M  ·  darker cell = higher sales"
Headline Heatmap.ko: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( '날짜'[월] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [매출] ) ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], DESC ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], ASC ) RETURN "가장 높은 달 " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, '날짜'[월], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MAXX ( hi, [매출] ) / 10000, "#,0만" ) & "  ·  가장 낮은 달 " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, '날짜'[월], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [매출] ) / 10000, "#,0만" ) & "  ·  진한 칸일수록 매출이 크다"

sub.en: Sales · darker = higher · use +/− on row headers to expand or collapse
sub.ko: 만 원 · 진할수록 크다 · 행 머리글의 +/−로 펼치고 접기

sub.en: Bar = sales · darker cell = higher margin · red = down vs last year
sub.ko: 막대 = 매출 크기 · 진한 칸 = 이익률이 높음 · 빨간 글자 = 전년보다 줄어듦
